resources.string: Compact translucent playback and speed controls. Tap the chevron to collapse or expand; hold it to drag. Tap ± for 1 km/h steps; hold to repeat. Stopping simulation removes the panel.
Display over other apps: permission needed
Open system settings → Apps → Special app access → Display over other apps to allow RouteForge Chinese.

For long simulations, allow background activity and disable battery optimization for this app. On OPPO: App info → Battery usage → Allow background activity. Moving simulation keeps the CPU awake and uses more battery. A system force stop still requires restarting manually.
System battery optimization: may restrict background work
Open this app in system Settings and allow background activity and unrestricted battery use.
